author: NovaLikesPvP
body:
I'm not defending Phil or this is not hes appeal or anything that he did or asked me to.
This is supposing "therealhorseman" was really hes account ( I dont know if it is ).

Just want to clarify some points.
Phil's final kill on hes stats were 6 days ago.
He joined the lobby 23 hours ago (actually when I'm making this post )
He was banned at this time 
April 7, 2016 at 11:50 PM

"Therealhorseman" was tempbanned minutes before him.
So, if he didnt played, he was banned of "ban evasión" because that account was with his ip? ( thinking staff ip_check is right ).

This is not an appeal, just for clarify some points.

Hope you understand.
Regards
Nova.
